source: {0} is for stores that keep one file per message. It returns the file of one key in a locale: a {1}, and the {2} id to create it with when it is not the format of its extension. A new message of the key goes to that file instead of a resource that already holds other keys, and the file is created when it does not exist. A rename moves each message to the file of the new key, and a delete that leaves the file of its key empty deletes the file. Return {3} for keys that live in shared files.
text: {0} 適用於每則訊息各存成一個檔案的儲存方式。它會傳回某個語系中單一鍵所在的檔案：一個 {1}，以及在該檔案不是依副檔名判定的格式時，用來建立它的 {2} id。該鍵的新訊息會寫入這個檔案，而不是已包含其他鍵的資源，且檔案不存在時會被建立。重新命名會將每則訊息移到新鍵的檔案，刪除後若該鍵的檔案變空，則會刪除該檔案。對於存放在共用檔案中的鍵，請傳回 {3}。
